events.outcome: Current Fortress FAQ establishes 365-day validity after activation and another 365 days after a top-up of at least HKD10. Current FAQ also documents real-name registration, physical-SIM-only service, voice/SMS behavior and number-recycling caveats; 2026 community users continue to report HK retail availability and HKD10 annual maintenance.

Fortress currently lists the reusable physical haha SIM at HK$50 with HK$50 stored balance. The reviewed product page shows current direct Fortress availability with store pickup; the retained August 2026 independent thread also reports HK$50 Fortress online/store acquisition.

Current Fortress FAQ states that the SIM is valid for 365 days after activation and that each top-up of HK$10 or more extends validity by another 365 days. Purchasing a data package does not extend validity. An expired SIM may be considered for reactivation within 14 days, without guarantee; after more than 14 days it cannot be reactivated.
Fortress currently says haha SIM does not support eSIM and an existing physical haha SIM cannot be transferred to eSIM. The route remains physical-SIM-only.

Fortress requires real-name registration for Hong Kong local service and accepts HKID or applicable travel-document details for individual registration. The linked 3HK prepaid registration flow relies on the SIM obtaining network service and an SMS/OTP step. Reviewed official material does not establish a guaranteed mainland-China-first activation path.

Current Fortress FAQ supports roaming voice and SMS charged from stored balance and warns that related services cannot be used when balance is insufficient. This establishes ordinary roaming-SMS capability subject to service/balance conditions, not bank/app OTP reliability.

Current Fortress FAQ warns that random real-name-registration verification can suspend call/SMS service if required verification is not completed, and that recycled Hong Kong numbers can retain third-party platform history that may block social-app registration. These are material continuity risks independent of the low annual keep cost.

data.acquisitionSummary: Fortress sells haha SIM through Hong Kong Fortress stores/eStore. Current community users in 2026 report straightforward Fortress retail availability and a typical HKD50 card purchase, but the official FAQ rather than seller/community price claims controls lifecycle facts.

keep.action: Top up HKD10 or more before expiry. Current Fortress FAQ says each qualifying top-up automatically extends SIM validity by 365 days; buying a data package does not extend validity.

data.chinaActivation: Current provider FAQ does not establish a guaranteed mainland-China-first activation path. It states activation occurs when the physical SIM is inserted and activation SMS/number are received; local Hong Kong use requires real-name registration. Preserve overseas-use reports as community evidence rather than a provider guarantee.
data.kyc: Current Fortress FAQ requires real-name registration information including HKID or travel-document details for applicable registration flows. Do not promote community no-KYC workarounds as a supported route.
data.payment: Top-up is managed through the haha TRAVEL App; foreign-card or mainland payment acceptance is not provider-guaranteed in the reviewed material.
data.roamingSms: Current provider FAQ supports roaming text/voice subject to account balance and charges. 2026 community users report mainland-China SMS reception, but service-specific OTP success is not guaranteed; Fortress also warns that recycled numbers can retain third-party platform history.
data.refund: Expired lines may be considered for reactivation within 14 days; approval is not guaranteed and real-name registration may need to be completed again.
data.tariffSummary: HKD10-or-more top-up extends SIM validity by 365 days. Physical SIM only; real-name registration rules and third-party platform/recycled-number risk remain material.

data.acquisitionSummary: Fortress currently lists the reusable physical haha SIM at HK$50 with HK$50 stored balance. The product is currently sold directly by Fortress with store pickup; a retained August 2026 independent thread also reports HK$50 Fortress online/store acquisition.

keep.action: Top up HK$10 or more before expiry to extend SIM validity by 365 days. Current Fortress FAQ explicitly says purchasing a data package does not extend validity. After expiry, reactivation may be considered within 14 days but is not guaranteed; after more than 14 days the SIM cannot be reactivated.

data.chinaActivation: Current Fortress instructions describe activation by inserting the physical SIM and receiving an activation SMS/number with WiFi disabled. The linked 3HK registration path also relies on network/SMS steps. Reviewed official material does not explicitly guarantee first activation from mainland China, so do not present this as a guaranteed China-first route.
data.kyc: Real-name registration is compulsory for Hong Kong local service. Fortress lists HKID or applicable travel-document details for individual registration, while the linked 3HK prepaid flow uses identity-document capture plus network/SMS verification. The product-page wording that registration is compulsory for Hong Kong service only is not treated as authorization to promote an unregistered overseas OTP workaround.
data.payment: Top-up is handled through the haha TRAVEL App. The reviewed current material does not establish universal acceptance of mainland-China-issued payment cards or a provider-guaranteed mainland payment path.
data.roamingSms: Fortress documents roaming SMS/voice charged from stored balance; insufficient balance can stop related services. Two independent Telegram registration-verification reports are mixed/negative (one failure and one failure-then-success), so they do not establish dependable Telegram or bank/app OTP reliability.
data.refund: If the SIM has expired for 14 days or less, Fortress may consider reactivation but does not guarantee approval and real-name registration may need to be completed again. After more than 14 days, reactivation is unavailable.
data.holdReason: Exact mainland bank/app OTP reliability is unverified; the Telegram sample is only two independent mixed/negative observations, and official material does not explicitly guarantee mainland-China first activation. Keep this route backstage.

guideSteps: Acquire the current reusable physical haha SIM from Fortress; the reviewed direct product is HK$50 with HK$50 stored balance.
